scope: Runner and immutable baseline preparation only; no Remotion render and no delivery installation executed.

cli.validateOnly: --validate-only is read-only and exits before writing running lock/bundle/media

inputLockRequirements.files: Every src file, package.json, package-lock.json, docs/story-v5.json and every public file, each with path, sha256 and independent in-project snapshot. Optional snapshotSHA256 must equal sha256. Duplicate entries refused.
inputLockRequirements.master: Exactly 25621/30 seconds, one stereo 48 kHz audio stream; no trim/pad/stretch

renderingBehavior.masterMux: ffmpeg video copy plus complete master encoded once as AAC 320k / 48 kHz from zero
renderingBehavior.videoPayloadCheck: SHA256 of copied encoded video packet payload must match silent/candidate
renderingBehavior.color: BT.709 limited range required; any silent metadata remux preserves pre-remux artifact
renderingBehavior.sourceFreeze: All source hashes/snapshots, src and public inventories, all bundled public hashes, runner, lock, Chromium and immutable baseline rechecked before installation
renderingBehavior.gpu: Process-local Windows Launcher hook and actual SystemInfo GPU capture retained; no GPU hook applied during preparation
renderingBehavior.disk: Separate Remotion temporary and project-output volume budgets, includes silent video, optional silent color archive, candidate, installation copy, public bundle, audit PCM and RAM estimate
renderingBehavior.installation: Inherited verified atomic staging and exact baseline rollback retained; not exercised

executedChecks.installedMutedParameter: confirmed in installed renderer implementation; no browser launched
executedChecks.immutableBaselineCopies: Four archive copies or byte-identical existing copies verified; no differing existing file overwritten

audioComparisonFunctionOnActualExistingF.note: Tests the new comparator against an existing encoded file and a shifted sample array; does not assert the future V6 candidate has already rendered or passed.

oldSourceLockRejection.interpretation: Expected rejection of the old incomplete snapshot schema, not a positive final preflight.

pendingChecks: Run positive --validate-only with root's final V6 source lock after hand/audio/story candidates are installed and frozen.
Actual full Remotion render, GPU capture, mux, all-frame decode, final candidate audio and visual review remain unexecuted.
